summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive iOS Smart app page object that extends SmartFlow base class. It provides extensive automation support for printer discovery, setup, and management workflows. The class implements multiple printer connection methods including WiFi, Ethernet, IP address, and serial number. It features robust error handling with configurable timeouts and exception raising, platform-specific logic for iOS and MAC, retry mechanisms for dynamic content loading, and comprehensive UI validation methods. The class follows the Page Object Model pattern with clear separation between verification methods (verify_*), action methods (select_*, click_*), and utility methods (get_*, search_*). It handles various edge cases including empty printer lists, WiFi connectivity issues, Bluetooth popups, and permission requests. The implementation includes extensive logging for debugging and analytics purposes, making it suitable for enterprise-scale test automation.
